name: PT-141

protocolDosing.frequency: as needed, max once daily and 8 per month
protocolDosing.notes: Vyleesi prefilled autoinjector solution (room temp); MC4R-preferring agonist for HSDD; t½ ~2.7 h. Gray-market lyophilized vials require BAC water + refrigeration

effects: Melanocortin receptor agonist (MC3R/MC4R) — FDA-approved as Vyleesi for HSDD in premenopausal women (2019)
Increases sexual desire via central CNS mechanism — unique non-hormonal HSDD treatment
FDA-approved dose: 1.75 mg SC auto-injector 45 min before anticipated sexual activity; max 1x/day, 1x/8 weeks
Nausea most common (40%); flushing, headache, vomiting; transient blood pressure increase (~6 mmHg)
Hyperpigmentation (face, gums, breasts) with repeated use — monitor
Contraindicated with high cardiovascular disease risk; avoid with antihypertensives on same day
Grey-market versions often Melanotan II mislabeled — dose verification critical
